notes.title: Watch the new trailer for The Final Fragment!
notes.content:
We’re so excited to reveal the trailer for The Final Fragment during The Ukrainian Games Festival 2025!


Check out the trailer to get a feel for the game!


[previewyoutube="zTrGXq9WLxI;full"][/previewyoutube]

Throw away failed poems, pretend you know what you’re doing and listen to the music until it fades. 



As you immerse yourself into the warm interiors of the Kobylianska Arts Academy, pay attention to everything. The Final Fragment is a tender character study, where every accidental breath, word or look might hide secret feelings.



Also don't forget to follow us for updates on our socials, such as Twitter, Bluesky and Tiktok!
